hypothesis: Current 5Hz predictions quantize transitions to five-frame intervals; continuous interpolation followed by 25Hz structured decoding may improve interval boundaries
fixed_parameters: Same H/A/D transition costs and boundary expert as before. No cost, smoothing, duration or frame-offset search. Interpolate separately within each half.
development: Read only saved native development probabilities and out-of-fold native predictions. No retraining or changes to ongoing V13 folds.
criterion: Official spellF1 mean, worst case and per-game changes; do not confuse five correlated observation variants with independent matches
interpretation: Decoder selection on reused external development, not a fresh confirmation. Original frozen candidates remain byte-identical.
public_policy: No competition labels or public evaluation
